column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Seraphim's flashback with Marco
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Everyone seems to bully you for not having any individuality, but...
I don't see it that way!
You just want to get along with everyone,
and you simply don't want anyone to dislike you, right?
Maybe... that's what they call cooperation, something lost long ago...
That's what I think your individuality is.
I also think the idea of one person ruling another is wrong somehow,
and anyway, I rather like that about you!
